title: Sub-daily FRP forecasting over Mediterranean wildfires: reproduction package
description:
Code, pre-registration, model checkpoints and per-event results for a study of sub-daily Fire Radiative Power (FRP) forecasting over Mediterranean wildfires, driven by EUMETSAT LSA SAF FRP-PIXEL retrievals from MSG/SEVIRI and ERA5 covariates.

A persistence-residual neural forecaster is compared against log-space gradient boosting under a registration committed before the single evaluation of a sequestered test block of 46 fires of the 2025 season, followed by a labelled exploratory replication on 32 fires of 2026 and on six alternative encoders. The pre-registered primary test does not reject: the deep model attains lower per-event error on 19 of 29 events, one short of its pre-declared rejection region.

This release contains the pre-registration and its lock bundle, the frozen scoring script, the ten ensemble checkpoints loaded at the single access, every per-event result table for both blocks and the encoder comparison, the 162-event catalogue with its quality-gate and independence audits, and the figures of the letter with the scripts that draw them. The derived data cube and the per-event hourly tables are deposited separately under concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20627568.

Version 1.0.0 of this repository, an earlier version of the study whose four-event evaluation was not independent, is preserved unchanged; the present pre-registration verifies one archived model against it by checksum.
